Assessment of drug-drug interactions among outpatients by different databases
QIN Weiwei，ZHANG Qian，YIN Yingqing，SUN Limin，CAI Bocheng，ZHONG Mingkang ( Department of Pharmacy，Huashan Hospital，Fudan University，Shanghai 200040，China)【ABSTRACT 】 AIM To assess the incidence，severity and sources of drug-drug interactions ( DDIs) among outpatients who visited multiple clinics at a medical center in China． METHODS This was a one week，retrospective and observational study． Mcdex，Micromedex and MIMS drug interaction databases were used to identify DDIs and to assess the severity of DDIs． RESULTS ①Incidence: A total of 2 117 patients were included． Mcdex，Micromedex and MIMS identified the numbers of 2 130，283 and 1 068 DDIs，respectively． The incidences of DDIs in the 3 compendia were 100． 1 DDIs /100 patients，13． 4 DDIs /100 patients and 50． 4 DDIs /100 patients respectively． ②Severity: A number of 31 DDIs were identified as major in at least 2 DDI compendia，which most commonly involved cardiovascular agents，antibacterial agents and central nervous system agents． ③ Sources: Of those DDIs identified by Micromedex，6． 2 inner clinic DDIs /100 patients and 7． 1 inter clinics DDIs /100 patients were identified ( 6． 2% vs 7． 1% ，P ＞ 0． 05) ． CONCLUSION ①The incidence of DDIs among outpatients who visited multiple clinics was relatively high and had clinical significance． The inter clinics DDIs should not be ignored as they accounted for half the incidence of DDIs among outpatients． ②There was a lack of consistency in the inclusion and grading of drug interactions across the 3 drug compendia． Healthcare providers should reconcile the discrepancies to get a good evaluation of DDIs． Surveillance software and pharmacist ’ s efforts should be added to identify the inter clinic DDIs．药物相互作用( drug-drug interactions，DDIs) 可致疗效增强甚至不良反应，或疗效减弱甚至治疗失败。 随着用药数量增加，DDIs 发生率增加［1］。 作为一种可预防的治疗错误，DDIs 越来越受到重视［2］。 利用 DDIs 评价数据库对处方进行审核是减少或避免不合理用药的有效手段［3 － 4］。 国内外知名的 DDIs 查询数据库有 Mcdex 数据库( 四川美康公司) ，Micromedex 数据库( Thomson Reuters 公司) 和MIMS 数据库( 美迪医讯公司) 等。 然而，不同数据库中的 DDIs 信息不一致现象普遍［5 － 7］，DDIs 严重程度及临床证据等级也存在较大差异［8］。
